title: Optimal Control Variates for Survey Sampling and Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.15333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a family of control variate estimators for variance reduction in design-based survey sampling and causal inference, with and without interference. In these settings, inverse probability weighting (IPW) estimators are widely used, but may have large variance when sampling, treatment, or exposure probabilities are small. Building on the observation that several common estimators, including the Hajek, normalized, and augmented inverse probability weighting (AIPW) estimators, correct the Horvitz-Thompson estimator by canceling part of its randomness, we provide a unified interpretation of these estimators as special cases of a general control variate estimator. We then construct optimal control variates that can further reduce the finite sample variance compared to these common estimators. We parameterize the proposed control variates by their bases and characterize the optimal bases through a stochastic optimization formulation.

translated_title: 调查抽样与因果推断中的最优控制变量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15333v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一族控制变量估计器，用于基于设计下的调查抽样和因果推断中的方差缩减，包括有无干扰的情况。在这些设置中，逆概率加权（IPW）估计器被广泛使用，但当抽样、处理或暴露概率较小时，其方差可能很大。基于对若干常见估计器（包括Hajek、归一化和增强逆概率加权（AIPW）估计器）通过抵消Horvitz-Thompson估计器的部分随机性来纠正其偏差的观察，我们将这些估计器统一解释为一般控制变量估计器的特例。随后，我们构造了最优控制变量，与这些常见估计器相比，能进一步减少有限样本方差。我们通过其基函数对提出的控制变量进行参数化，并通过随机优化公式刻画最优基函数。
tldr: 本文提出了一族统一框架下的最优控制变量估计器，通过随机优化刻画最优基函数，显著降低了调查抽样和因果推断中IPW类估计器的有限样本方差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified family of optimal control variate estimators, characterized via stochastic optimization of basis functions, to substantially reduce finite-sample variance of IPW-type estimators in survey sampling and causal inference.
